staticPartitionCheck.note: Reassembly starts from the transparent-hole base and alpha-composites only the exported source-pixel crop assets. This validates the static file partition only; it does not validate clean-plate quality or movement realism.

reviewNotes: Generated mask guides are not used as foreground RGB; the mask fit still needs human review around letter/photo overlap.
The six major track corridors are manually traced and may leave a residual line where the mask falls short.
Paper contours are irregular hand-traced first passes; they are more detailed than rectangular panels but need edge-by-edge review.
Mountain and city/cloud masks have SIFT/RANSAC fit reports; their internal depth split lines remain semantic first passes.
Every moved layer needs a matching filled hole under the source footprint. The base file intentionally leaves holes transparent pending Agent C fill.
